description: Portrait of O'Keeffe in her home sitting on a banco holding her dog Beau . O'Keeffe dressed in a black wrap dress  sits with her hands wrapped  around her big dark fluffy chow dog, smiling at the camera.  Raking light falls from the window above illuminating half her face; white adobe wall, cushions, rug, and a plywood table are visible.
title: O'Keeffe with Beau
